name: Jockey by TwelveLabs
description: Connect your photo and video library to Claude. Ask Jockey to find any person, place, or moment across your entire photo and video collection. Get answers with grounded citations and playback rendered through the Jockey Interactive Language (JIL). Powered by TwelveLabs' Marengo and Pegasus models.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jockey by TwelveLabs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jockey by TwelveLabs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.twelvelabs.io/jockey/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jockey by TwelveLabs MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jockey by TwelveLabs provides these MCP tools: jockey_add_media, jockey_create_knowledge_store, jockey_list_knowledge_store_items, jockey_list_knowledge_stores, jockey_query, jockey_render_response, jockey_request_upload_link, and jockey_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jockey by TwelveLabs?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jockey by TwelveLabs in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Jockey by TwelveLabs MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jockey by TwelveLabs requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jockey by TwelveLabs is developed by TwelveLabs, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
